read_csv_file: create a function that reads a TSV CSV file and returns structured data with mentions, contexts, candidates, and gold entities
read_conll_file: build a function that parses CoNLL format files and merges textual data with pregenerated entity linking data
eval: run evaluation metrics to calculate precision, recall, and F1 score for named entity linking predictions
CoNLLDataset: create a CoNLL dataset object that loads training and test splits with coreference resolution and candidate generation
FetchCandidateEntities: build a candidate entity fetcher that looks up mention spans against precomputed entity dictionaries and returns ranked candidates
